questions.text: Which of the four financial fitness pillars involves putting the money you keep to work so it can increase over time?
questions.explanation: Grow means putting the money you kept to work so it can increase over time.

questions.text: True or false: A negative net worth indicates personal failure.
questions.explanation: Negative net worth simply shows current position, not failure.

questions.text: Which statement best describes the primary action in the "pay yourself first" system?
options: Transfer a set amount to savings immediately when income arrives
Save after all bills are paid
Only save leftover money at month end
Skip saving until an emergency arises
questions.explanation: Pay yourself first moves savings before any other spending.

questions.text: True or false: An emergency fund should be invested in the stock market to maximize growth.
questions.explanation: Emergency funds stay in liquid, low‑risk accounts, not invested.
